Commentary.Commentary: An uphill task lies ahead for India now. They're facing a big first innings total at home which is a rare thing for them nowadays. Let's see how they battle this situation. Tea has been taken so join us back in a bit for India's reply.

Shami and Yadav were good in patches but could have been more disciplined. Ashwin, the trump card was a let down this time as he was carved away for runs. Jadeja was most successful as he took 3 wickets.

Earlier in the innings, England rode high on the back of the brilliant 179-run partnership between Root and Ali. Both of them went on to score well deserved centuries. There was another crucial partnership between Stokes and Bairstow too as the duo added 99 runs. The Indian bowlers tried hard but weren't effective enough and the fielders didn't support them well.

Brilliant batting effort by England as they have put up a huge score on the board to put India on the back foot. In this session, their approach was a bit restrained and they applied themselves well. Jadeja came back after lunch and picked up two quick wickets creating an opportunity for them to bowl the visitors out but Stokes and Ansari stitched together a handy partnership. Ben Stokes was the one who stood tall and he smashed an entertaining century. He led a charmed life but was equally unfortunate to get out just at the stroke of tea.

Shortish outside off, Stokes goes onto his back foot and cuts it through point for a single.
Flighted ball around off, turning away, Stokes tries to defend but misses it completely.

Time for Drinks. A good first hour for the English side as they scored at a fast click to add 60 runs on the board. They would be disappointed to lose Ali but Stokes and Bairstow haven't allowed the Indian bowlers to settle down. Can the home side fight back?
Loopy ball on off, Bairstow strides forward and defends it to the off side.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Stokes kneels and sweeps it towards Pujara at short leg who takes it on the body and deflects it behind for a single.
Bairstow drives it with the spin through mid off for a single.
Floated outside off, defended towards point.
SIX! THAT'S HAMMERED! Bairstow advances to the loopy ball on middle and off and hits it cleanly down the ground for a maximum. Clean strike that!

Going down leg, Jonny looks to clip it but misses and the ball lobs to the short leg fielder off his pads who pouches it. A shout for a catch is turned down. They were anyways not confident. The replays show that there was no bat involved.
Full around middle, defended off the front foot.
A tad short outside off, cut through covers for a couple.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker on leg stump, Stokes looks to defend but is rapped on the pads. A stifled appeal but in vain.
THAT ONE TURNED! On a length on middle, spins venomously. Stokes looked to play at first but has to withdraw.
Pitched outside leg, spinning back in. Stokes defends it to short leg.
Pressed forward to the full delivery outside off and defends nicely.
Flatter again on middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Quicker one on off, Bairstow camps back and defends it to covers.
Tossed up outside off, defended with an angled bat towards point.
Stokes advances down the track converting it into a full toss and drills it to long on for a single.
Quicker one at the stumps, Stokes comes forward and defends it to the off side.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Floated outside off, defended off the front foot.
Bairstow stays back and defends.
A tad short outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Down the leg side, nudged round the corner for a single.
Comes down the track and clips it through mid-wicket.
Stokes pushes it gently to the covers.
Tossed up on middle, Bairstow makes room and places it towards covers. Jadeja is quick to get around it and hurls in a throw at the bowler's end but misses. Jonny was safely in.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stokes sweeps it with the spin through backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, defended towards the leg side.
Floated up on middle, spinning down. Stokes goes back and looks to nudge it but misses. There is an appeal for caught behind but in vain!
AMIT MISHRA comes to bowl.
Jonny works it with the spin down the leg side.
Tossed up around off, turning in. Jonny looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Muted appeal for LBW turned down.
Bairstow defends it with the spin towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up just outside off, Bairstow gets it from the outer half of his bat past slip for a couple.
Good running between the wickets! Jonny brings out the paddle sweep down to backward square leg for a couple.
Nicely tossed up outside off, Bairstow leans forward and defends it to the off side.
Comes over the wicket and bowls a length ball on off, Ben hangs back and defends it nicely.
On a length outside off, Stokes watches it closely and lets it go.
FOUR! HE IS LOOKING OMINOUS! Fullish ball shaping in from outside off, Stokes has the line covered and drives it emphatically down the ground. The ball races to the fence!
Full length ball at 141 clicks outside off, Stokes leans forward and defends it down the track.
On a length on off, Stokes camps back and defends it to mid on.
Fullish delivery wide outside off, Stokes drives it through covers for a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Bairstow comes forward and defends.
Quicker one at the stumps, Stokes flicks it through square leg for a single.
Going down leg, Stokes nudges it round the corner.
Stokes presses forward and defends down the pitch.
Pitches it on leg stumps, turning in. Stokes is squared up as he looks to defend but gets an outside edge past first slip.
Nicely tossed up on middle and leg, Stokes stays leg side to defend it.
Sprayed down the leg side, Bairstow looks to clip it through but misses. End of a successful over, a wicket maiden!
Bouncer to Bairstow to start with! He ducks under it nicely.
JONNY BAIRSTOW walks in next.

OUT! WHY DID YOU LEAVE THAT MOEEN? On a length outside off, it is always going to be angling in from there. Ali for some reason points his bat skywards and only turns back to see his off stump going for a toss. A tragic end to a brilliant knock. He has truly put England in a comfortable position.
On a length angling into Moeen. He camps back and pushes it towards wide mid on.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, Moeen blocks it.
Fullish ball around off, swinging in. Ali strides forward and defends nicely.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! THAT'S DRILLED! Advances down the track and drives it hard through mid on for a superb boundary.
Stokes looks to sweep the loopy delivery but misses and is hit on the pads.
Floated up on middle and leg, defended off the front foot.
Quicker one on off, Ben defends it towards covers.
Flatter ball from around the wicket, Stokes camps back and defends.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN comes to bowl.
Ali strides forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Fullish ball around off, defended off the outer half of the bat towards covers.
Comes around the wicket.
On a length wide outside off, stays a bit low. Ali has his feet planted at the crease as he plays away from the body but misses.
FOUR! Straying on the hips, Ali stays back and nudges it to the vacant fine leg region for a boundary.
Bouncer on middle and leg, Moeen ducks underneath it.
Back of a length ball angling across Ali. He looks to defend it but gets an inside edge towards square leg.
A bit loose that time! Back of a length ball outside off, Stokes is off balance as he looks to pull it but misses.
On a similar length at the stumps, Stokes drives it towards mid on.
Fullish ball around off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
FOUR! SHOT! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Ben leans into the drive and caresses it through point and the ball whistles away to the boundary.
50-run stand up between Ali and Stokes.
Back of a length ball outside off, Ali glides it through gully for a single.
Full length ball outside off, Ali strides forward and defends it solidly.
On a good length outside off, shapes in after pitching. Stokes hops back to defend but is beaten.
Pacy delivery attacking the stumps, Stokes comes forward and defends it nicely.
FOUR! THAT'S PLAYED WITH AUTHORITY! Shortish ball directed at the body, Stokes stands tall and pulls it fiercely through mid-wicket. The ball rockets to the fence.
Shortish and wide outside off, Stokes throws his bat at it but misses.
THAT'S A PEACH! In the corridor of uncertainty outside off, angling in. Stokes pushes at it tamely and is beaten all ends up.
Fulll length ball outside off, Stokes leans forward and defends it to covers.
FOUR! In between full and good length outside off, angling away. Ali leans forward and drives it through cover-point for a superb boundary. 12 runs off the over!
Fuller length ball outside off, Ali doesn't flirt with that.
FOUR! Poor effort from Gambhir! On a length wide outside off, Moeen stays back and cuts it fiercely towards point. Gambhir fumbles and allows the ball to go through to the boundary.

FOUR! BEAUTIFULLY PLAYED! Fullish delivery on middle, Ali is well balanced at the crease as he clips it beautifully through mid-wicket. Jadeja gives a good chase but fails to keep the ball in with his slide.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery!
Fullish delivery around off, angling away. Moeen points his bat skywards and lets it go.
UMESH YADAV to share the new cherry.
On a length angling into Stokes. He stands tall and defends it down the pitch.
Back of a length around off, Ben camps back and pushes it through the covers for a couple.
On a length angling in from outside off, Stokes watches it closely and leaves it.
4th Test century for Moeen Ali!

Back of a length ball outside off, Ali camps back and plays it with soft hands towards point. Sets off for the run and reaches home safely to complete his ton. Lifts his arms skywards and the dressing room appreciates his fine effort. It has been a superb innings and he would look to carry on.
This time the bouncer is well directed angling into middle. Ali drops his wrists and lets it go with good technique.
Shortish delivery outside off, doesn't bounce that high. Ali sways away from the line and leaves it alone.

We are ready to kick start the first session. The players and umpires walk out into the middle. MOEEN ALI and BEN STOKES to continue their innings. Ali will take strike and he would be itching to get that single to complete his 4th ton. Meanwhile, INDIA HAVE TAKEN THE NEW BALL. MOHAMMED SHAMI to begin with the new cherry. Two slips, a gully and forward short leg in place. Here we go...

The home side would look to make early inroads and have a go at  the lower middle order with the new ball. The pitch is playing true but there is a possibility of it taking a bit more turn today. Let's see if the hosts are able to fight back. It promises to be a cracking day of cricketing action!

Hello and a warm welcome on Day 2 of the first Test between India and England in Rajkot. England are poised nicely at the moment and would look to press the advantage further. Ali is playing a brilliant knock and has countered the Indian bowlers nonchalantly. He is nearing his ton and Stokes seems to have got his eye in.
...DAY 2, SESSION 1...

India would be ruing the dropped catches early in the first session that could have given them the early momentum. Apart from that though, England's batsmen haven't offered any chances at all especially against spin. The track has played well although it's been a bit slow. The visitors will want to pile on the runs tomorrow as well. India will hope to restrict England as much as possible. Tune in at 0930 IST tomorrow for the second day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

It was a hard day's work for India's bowlers. With the surface not offering much turn, the spin trio weren't quite able to trouble the batsmen. Ashwin and Jadeja did bowl well in the first session but thereafter weren't quite effective while Mishra had an off day. Umesh and Shami got the ball to reverse although they could have been more accurate in their spells. The latter did have slight issues with fitness too.

A very good day for England after opting to bat. Joe Root's century and Moeen Ali's unbeaten 99 were the highlights of the day for the visitors. The duo's 179-run stand put the tourists on track after going to lunch at a slightly wobbly 102/3 which included the big one of skipper Cook. Although Root departed towards the fag end of the day to a debatable decision, Ali batted on with Stokes to prevent further damage.
Floated up outside off, Stokes lunges forward and defends it to the off side. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 1!
On a length on middle, Ben camps back and defends.
Ben pushes it against the spin towards mid off.
Outside off again, defended to the off side.
Floated up outside off, Ben strides forward and defends.
Juicy full toss on off, Ali mistimes his shot as he hits it aerially down to long on for a single. Moves to 99. Can he get his century in this over?
Ali drives it with the spin through mid off for a single. Moves to 98.
Moeen advances down to the loopy delivery and is struck on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down. He was way down the pitch.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Ali presses forward and blocks.
Floated on off, defended back to the bowler.
Outside off, spinning in. Ali defends it from the crease.
Ben steps down the track and looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his back pad and the ball bounces over the stump to the keeper.
Full delivery, Stokes comes forward and defends.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Loose delivery and it gets the treatment! Short delivery at the stumps, Stokes rocks back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Ali drives it against the spin through mid off for a single.
Stays back to the length delivery and defends it down the pitch.
AMIT MISHRA comes back.
Tossed up at the stumps, Ben stays back and defends.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stokes advances down the track and is hit on the pads as he kept his bat behind. There is an appeal for LBW but it's turned down.
Ben stays back this time and defends it past short leg.
Stokes comes forward and defends it.
SIX! SHOT! Stokes comes down the track to the loopy delivery and lofts it beautifully over long on. The ball clears the boundary easily.
Straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a single.
Stokes gets hurried on to the pull shot as the length was a bit up to attempt it. He fails to connect and is hit on the thigh pad.
Fuller length ball at the stumps, pushed towards mid on.
Shortish delivery going down leg, Ben looks to pull it hard but misses.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery as Stokes again defends to short cover.
Full length ball outside off, Stokes puts in a good stride forward and defends it to short cover.
Moeen advances down the track and defends it. Nervous nineties for him.
Angling towards leg stump, helped towards the leg side for a single.
Stokes plays for the turn but gets squared up as it straightens a touch. Takes the outside edge and goes down to third man. Couple taken!
Stokes stays back to this one on leg stump and defends it.
Advances down the track to the loopy delivery and clips it towards short mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Tossed up on off, Ali strides forward and defends down the pitch.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN comes back to bowl. A slip and short leg in place.
Straying on the pads, nudged down to fine leg for a single.
Full length ball outside off, Ali lunges forward and plays a free flowing drive straight to extra over.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched to point.
On a length and at the stumps, Moeen defends it from the crease.
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Ali strides forward and creams it through covers for a superb boundary.
WELL BOWLED! Good length ball outside off, Ali pushes at it tentatively away from the body and is beaten.
On a length outside off, punched through the covers for a single. Moves to 90.
Sprayed down the leg side, Ali looks to flick it but doesn't connect.
Length ball around middle, Moeen stays back and pushes it down the track.

Shami is down again in pain. The physio is out there to attend to him. It would be good for him if he decides to walk off the field now. Can take a good rest and start afresh tomorrow. Ravi Shastri on air is livid and feels that the pacer's actions are 'bordering on stupidity'. Well, Shami decides to continue again.
On a length and at the stumps, Ali defends it to the leg side.
Angling down leg side, Ali fails to flick it as it kisses his pads and goes through to the keeper.
Fuller length ball outside off, Ali pushes it from the inner half of his bat towards mid off.
Full length ball outside off, Ben lunges forward confidently and defends it to short cover.
FOUR! FINE SHOT! Shortish delivery directed at the body, Stokes stands tall and pulls it down to the vacant long leg boundary.
In between full and good length on off, Ben puts a big stride in and defends solidly.
Very full ball just outside off, pushed back in the direction of the bowler.
Fuller length ball outside off, Stokes leans forward and defends it to the covers.
He is cranking up the pace here! Bowls a length delivery outside off, at 145 clicks, zips through after pitching. Stokes shoulders his arms to that one.
Full length ball going down leg, Ali looks to clip it through but the ball strikes the pad and carries to the keeper.
Stokes drives this one through mid off and gets a single
Fullish ball outside off, Stokes comes forward and defends it to short cover.
On a length angling into Stokes. He clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery wide outside off, Stokes points his bat skywards and lets it through.
Pacy delivery attacking the stumps, Ali clips it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, zips through after pitching. Stokes is surprised by the bounce as he fends at it and gets beaten. Stifled appeal for caught behind turned down!
On a good length wide outside off, Ben lets it go through.
Bowls a beautiful delivery on back of a length outside off, angling in. Stokes pushes at it tamely and gets beaten.
Short point comes in place.
Full length ball outside off, Stokes leans forward and defends nicely towards covers.
Follows it up with a full length delivery at 141 clicks, attacking the stumps. Ben is up to it as he strides forward and defends it down the track.
On a length just outside off, Stokes camps back and defends it towards short cover.
Bowls it on a length on off, Ali comes forward and defends it towards mid on.
Ambles in and bowls a fullish delivery outside off, Moeen lets it go through.
SHAMI is again having trouble with his hamstring. Physio comes to attend him. He first looks to go back but decides to complete the over first.
Length delivery around off, angling in. Ali comes forward and defends it with the inner half of his bat down the pitch.
On a length wide outside off, Moeen doesn't flirt with that one.

Bowls it on a length, coming in with the angle. Ali camps back and looks to defend it but is rapped low on the pads. A loud appeal for LBW turned down by the umpire. Hawk Eye shows that it would have missed leg.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a fullish delivery that tails back in, Ali clips it towards mid-wicket.
MOHAMMED SHAMI comes in for a spell. Can he get some reverse swing here?
Full length ball outside off, left alone by Stokes.

Time for Drinks. A crucial breakthrough as Root was stamping his authority and threatening India big time. The home side will be breathing a bit easy and would look to take more. Meanwhile, BEN STOKES comes to the crease.

OUT! GONE! Big strike by Yadav! He almost made a mess of it though. Fuller outside off, Root drives it but cannot keep the stroke down. Pops back at Yadav who takes it initially but the ball pops out late. The umpires want to check if the bowler has celebrated too early. Soft signal is out from the umpire. The third umpire feels that Umesh had held it for a decent period of time before it spilled apparently in celebration. A bit confusing in the end but Root has to go after a really good knock. Can argue that he was a tad unlucky.
Yadav seems to have taken a return catch but has spilled it at almost the last moment. The umpires want to check if he held it long enough before it popped out. Soft signal is out.
Length ball on the pads, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Good length outside off, Ali blocks it firmly towards the bowler.
Length ball outside off, Root taps it to point for a single.
Good length outside off, Ali gets back and pushes it through point for a single.
UMESH YADAV is back on for another spell.
The second new ball is now available. India haven't taken it just yet.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Ali reaches out and bunts it towards mid off.
Floated outside off, Ali digs it out to the off side.
FOUR! Crunched! Flatter and a bit short outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a boundary. Positive stroke.
Flatter on off, Moeen goes for the cut but ends up chopping to point.
Fuller outside off, Ali drills it through the covers for a single.
Slider on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Drifting in on off, Ali steps out and blocks it.
Flighted on middle and leg, blocked off the front foot to the leg side.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a single.
Flatter and a bit short, Ali goes for the pull but mistimes it a bit. Clears square leg and goes to the deep for a single.
FOUR! More runs off sweeps! Floated outside leg, Root gets across to that one and gets the paddle away down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Drifting in around leg stump, Ali gets the lap sweep away off the glove down to fine leg. Got it very fine as the batsmen get three more.
Loopy and outside off, Moeen steps out and pushes it to short extra cover where Kohli makes a fine diving stop.
Drifting in from around off, blocked off the front foot on to the track.
Flatter and a bit short outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
Fuller on middle and off, dug out to short mid-wicket.
Slider on middle and leg, worked away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fired in on off, Root hangs back and jams it on to the pitch.
Darted in from around off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Floated on off, Ali steps out and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Flighted outside off, blocked off the front foot on to the track.
Flatter around off, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket. In the air for a while but doesn't carry to the fielder.
Root lunges forward and clips it towards mid on. Kohli fields and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. The frustration is beginning to show on India.
Stays back and defends it to the leg side.
FOUR! More pressure on India here! Floated outside off, Root gets down quickly on it and reverse sweeps it through backward point for a boundary. Ashwin looks a bit rattled.
Fuller on off, and again Ali has pushed the field back and gets a single to long on.
Long on in place now.
FOUR! More shots! Floated on middle, Ali slinks down the wicket and clobbers it over mid on for a boundary. The 150-run stand is up!
Outside off, Root lunges forward and clips it through mid on for a single.
Again Ali is down the track but spots the ball is not there for him to play the big shot, he drives it back down the wicket.
On middle and off, Ali comes down the track and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Stays back and punches it towards point off his crease.
Floated outside off, Ali comes down the wicket and defends it.
Fuller on off, Ali comes forward and clips it to mid-wicket.
Shorter on middle, Ali clips it towards mid-wicket but not for any runs.
Floated outside off, Root looks to square drive it but finds the fielder at cover-point.
Fuller on off, Ali gets what he wanted, an easy single through mid on for a single.
Ashwin has a chat with Kohli. The mid on drops back to long on.
Ali comes down and flicks it in the air towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Shots coming from England now! Floated on middle, Ali goes for the heave through the leg side. The ball goes just over mid on fielder for a boundary.
On off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Root goes back to work it through mid-wicket where Kohli stops the ball and prevents it.
Floated outside off, Ali comes down and defends it.
Shorter on middle, Ali stays back and works it nicely down to fine leg. Pujara comes across, stops the ball and saves a couple of runs for his side.
Flatter on the pads, Root clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Ali comes down a touch and clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower on off, turns in, Ali stays back and defends it towards short leg.
Floated outside off, Ali comes down the wicket and defends it back down the wicket.
Root keeps this one out off his back foot.
Takes a quick single with a push towards mid off. There is a direct hit but no  harm done.
Pushes this one to mid off from the crease.

Ali comes down the wicket and looks to clip it through but is hit on his pads. The players appeal but the umpire says no. Ashwin asks if there was an edge, the keeper and the umpire says there was one. The replays show that there was a slight inside edge there.
Floated on off, Ali comes forward and defends it.
Floated outside off, Ali comes down and drives it hard towards short extra cover where Kohli dives to his right and parries it towards mid off. Good effort!
Ali works it through square leg off his crease for a single. That went off the pads and the umpire signals it a leg bye.
Flatter on off, Root goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Stays back and Root defends it back down the wicket.
Short outside off, Root punches it off the outer half towards the offside.
SIX! SIGN OF INTENT! Flight from Jadeja, Root comes down the wicket in a jiffy and clobbers it over the bowlers's head for a maximum.
Bowls it on middle, pushed towards Root off his crease.
RAVINDRA JADEJA back on for a bowl.
On off, Ali pushes it to short extra cover.
Ali comes forward and pushes this to mid on off his crease.
Floated on middle, Ali comes forward and defends it.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Ali comes forward and defends it.
Bowls it on middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a single.
Floated on middle, Kohli drives it to silly mid on.
Fuller on middle and leg, Ali gets across and pushes it towards mid on.
Fuller and outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.
FOUR! Fab shot! Full and wide outside off, Ali leans into it and drives it through point as the ball races away to the fence for a boundary. That was in the air but also in the gap. Terrific stroke.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a single.
Fuller on middle and off, Ali goes across and clips it through mid-wicket to the deep. Three more added.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
11th Test ton for Root, 3rd against India and this is his first in Asia. Good innings!

Drifting in from around off, Root gets for the lap sweep. In the air but goes through the vacant short fine leg region towards the deep. Brace taken. Well played Joe! Calmly accepts the response of the crowd.
Fuller on middle and leg, Root goes across and clips it to the leg side.
Slider on middle and leg, Ali goes across to flick but it goes off the bat face. In the air for a while but gets through Pujara at short leg. Single taken.
Floated on leg stump, Root steps out to that one and whips it away to long on. Single taken.
Fuller on middle and off, Ali goes for a wild slog but gets the inside edge through square leg for a single.
Mohammed Shami is back on the field. Seems to be moving well which is good news for India.
Fuller on middle and off, Root gets across and clips it towards mid on.
Length ball outside off, steered towards deep backward point for a single.
Good length angled in on middle and off, Ali shuffles and tucks it to mid on.
Shortish down the leg side, Ali swivels to pull but misses.
Fuller outside off, Ali bunts it strongly back to the bowler.
Good length outside off, shaping away a bit, Root steers it to deep backward point for a single.
Loopy outside off, Ali gets on the front foot and defends it solidly.
Flighted on middle and off, dug out towards mid on.
Loopy on leg stump, Ali gets across and defends it to the leg side.
9th Test fifty for Ali.
Drifting away from outside off, Ali eases it through the covers for a brace. Smart knock so far from the all-rounder.
Slider on off, Ali gets across and works it to the leg side.
Floated around off, defended well off the front foot.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN to bowl from the other end.
Fuller on middle and off, tails in sharply as Root works it down to fine leg for a brace.
Full and wide outside off, Ali squeezes it through backward point for a single.
Length ball outside off, Root pushes it to the covers for a single.
Fuller and on the pads, clipped with the swing towards mid-wicket.
Good length around off, curving in, Root blocks it off the front foot.
Fuller and tailing in from around off, bunted past the bowler down the ground. Mid off goes to his right to stop it.

Welcome back for the final session of the day. Players and umpires are making their way to the middle. Can England consolidate on their position to drive home the advantage? It'll surely be a morale-booster for the tourists if they can win the first day of this long series. India need quick wickets to get back in the game. UMESH YADAV to begin proceedings after tea.
.....DAY 1, SESSION 3.....

Kohli tried all his bowlers with the spinners getting longer spells but nobody could create constant pressure on the batsmen. The fact that the hosts have bowled very few maidens till now shows how busy Root and Ali have been. The track has been good to bat on although a touch slow. A hint of reverse swing is available with the older ball but nothing alarming for the spinners just yet. Join us in a short while for the final session to find out which team takes the day's honors.

This session - 31.3 overs, 107 runs, 0 wickets. Dominant session for England. Root and Ali have stitched a valuable century stand that is still unbroken with both batsmen hardly looking in any trouble. The former is inching towards another Test ton while the all-rounder is nearing a half century. The duo's efforts have ensured that England are going to the tea break in a fairly good position.
On middle and leg, straightening a bit. Moeen keeps it out watchfully. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 1!
Loopy ball on off, defended towards the cover region.
Ali defends it against the spin towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, Moeen comes forward and defends it nicely.
Floated up outside off, Ali presses forward and defends it to the covers.
Root plays it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! Too close for comfort again as Root looks to clip it away again but is rapped on the pads. Muted appeal for LBW turned down! It was probably going down leg!

NOT OUT! Fuller length ball outside off, tailing in sharply. Root goes across and looks to clip it through but misses and is rapped on the pads. There is a loud appeal for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. Indians are consulting with each other and Kohli decides to take the review. There are two reds but it would have just clipped the leg stump. So, the on-field call stays and Root survives!
India have taken a review against Joe Root. It is regarding an LBW decision.
Back of a length outside off, shaping in a touch. Root is up on his toes as he defends it solidly.

Welcome back for the second session. Can England get their innings back on track or will India continue to make further inroads? We shall find out as the players and umpires make their way out to the middle. JOE ROOT will continue his innings and MOEEN ALI comes to the crease. RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN to continue his over.
.....DAY 1, SESSION 2....

It was a good bowling performance from all of India's bowlers. The pacers were unlucky not to get wickets with the new ball due to the fielders' mistakes. The spinners didn't get much purchase as you would expect on a normal day one pitch. Yet, Ashwin and Jadeja have used the other factors like angle, change in pace and drift to trouble the batsmen. Still a fairly good batting deck and Root is key for the tourists. First innings score is always vital in the sub-continent. Join us in a while for the second session.

India's session after having lost the toss. It didn't start well for them though as a flurry of catches were put down off the seamers early. There was a bit of movement off the deck but the dropped chances allowed Cook and debutant Hameed to settle in. It seemed like the England skipper would bat long but he was removed by Jadeja to a dubious lbw call that the former didn't review. Ashwin removed the debutant and then derailed Duckett at the stroke of lunch to give India the session's honors.

Fuller outside off, Cook gets the stride forward and eases it through the covers for a couple.
Fuller on off, blocked firmly off the front foot to the covers.
Length ball outside off, shaping away, Hameed doesn't offer a shot.
Another edge! This doesn't carry though. Good length outside off, Hameed pokes at it but gets the edge. Played with soft hands and so the nick doesn't carry to Kohli at second slip.
Good length outside off, a hint of shape away, Hameed lets it pass.
Fuller outside off, blocked firmly off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, angling in, Hameed lets it pass.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.

DROPPED BY VIJAY! India's slip cordon cannot seem to catch anything at the moment. Length ball outside off, Hameed drives loosely at it. Gets the outside edge that is put down by Vijay at first slip. It goes through the cordon. Single taken. India cannot afford to spill chances like this.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot to the off side.
Good length around off, defended well from the crease.
FOUR! Nicely done! Good length on the pads, glanced down to fine leg for a boundary by Hameed. Deft touch by the young opener. He's looked to be positive.
Full and down the leg side, Hameed misses the flick.

FOUR! Another edge goes away! Full and outside off, Cook drives away from the body once more. Gets the edge that flies past gully towards the fence. India's slip cordon is being tested big time very early in the game.
Play and a miss! Good length closer to off, angling in, holds its line to beat the outside edge.
Good length closer to off, blocked from the crease towards short cover.
Fullish and outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Short of a length on leg stump, Cook gets across and taps it towards the silly mid on region.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly towards short cover.
Length ball around off, pushed off the back foot through cover for a single.
Full and outside off, Cook gets on the front foot and defends it.
Back of a length outside off, Cook hangs back and punches it through the covers for a brace.
Fuller outside off, Cook gets on the front foot and defends it well.
That's a peach! Cook is really struggling at the moment although this delivery was too good for any batsman. Length ball angled in closer to off, Cook pushes at it but is beaten comprehensively.
Good length angled in from outside off, Cook pushes tentatively at it and is beaten once more.
FOUR! Good shot! This is nicely done by Hameed. Sees it short and wide outside off, he stays back and cuts it away uppishly over backward point. Aerial shot but also in the gap to find the fence.
Dug in short closer to off, Hameed evades the bumper.
FOUR! Streaky boundary! Shortish outside off, Hameed flashes at it without any footwork. Gets a thick slice that flies over the slips to the fence. Nerves of the debutant in play here.
Full and sliding down the leg side, Cook misses the flick. Saha dives to his left but cannot gather it cleanly. A bye taken.
Fuller around off, Hameed gets forward to that one and pushes it to the off side for a quick single. The debutant is off the mark in his Test career.
Length ball closer to off, Hameed pushes at it with soft hands. Gets the edge towards third slip on the bounce.
Full and angled in closer to off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Keeps it outside off, Cook is beaten on the poke once more. The England skipper is looking unusually tentative.
Fuller on the pads, Cook works it to the leg side.
Beaten again! Length ball outside off, Cook is beaten on the poke.

ANOTHER EDGE! Cook is looking nervous. Length ball outside off, he pushes tentatively but gets the nick that goes just past the left of Kohli at second slip. Another shape chance that hasn't been taken. A brace taken.
Fullish around off, Cook gets well forward and blocks it well.
UMESH YADAV to share the new ball.
Length ball on off, Hameed gets across and blocks it out well.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and outside off, Cook pushes at it but gets the edge again. This time goes on the bounce past Rahane for a single.

DROPPED AT GULLY! Back of a length from outside off, Cook plays a loose push away from the body. The outside edge flies to gully where Rahane gets to it but spills the chance. It was a sharp chance but you expect fielders like him to take it with ease. How much will this cost India? Cook is a very difficult batsman to dislodge once set.
Switches to around the wicket.
Length ball well outside off, this is an easier leave for Cook.
Squared up first ball! Good start by Shami. Back of a length closer to off, rears off the deck as Cook is beaten on the poke.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. ALASTAIR COOK and HASEEB HAMEED to open the batting for England. It shall be MOHAMMED SHAMI to take the new ball. Three slips and a gully in place. We are ready to roll!
The teams are out there for their respective National Anthems.

There was a lot of confusion regarding India's fifth bowler. It seemed like Hardik Pandya was set to debut while the team sheets showed Amit Mishra. It's confirmed now that the leg spinner is playing. So, two seamers and three spinners for the hosts.

VIRAT KOHLI states that it's a good pitch and feels it has enough for both the batsmen and bowlers. Hopes that his side can start well in the first session. Feels that India have played good cricket in recent times but doesn't want the hosts to be complacent. Insists that it's important to win crucial sessions. Says that they are playing with five bowlers which is mainly due to England's strong lower order.

ALASTAIR COOK says that they will bat first. Feels that it's a good pitch and expects the surface to crack up due to the heat. Opines that it'll take spin as the game progresses. States that the experience in Bangladesh has helped although it will be a tougher challenge facing India. Admits that his side is short of experience but feels that it is an exciting thing to have. Says that they are playing with 3 seamers and 3 spinners.
Time for the toss, Virat Kohli is ready to flip the coin. Heads is the call, it is a head. ENGLAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

Pitch report - Sunil Gavaskar feels that there is a bit grass on the track but adds that it is deceptive. There might be a little movement in the first hour but is still a bat-first pitch. The track will crack up as the game progresses to assist the spinners and the uneven bounce will come into play.

India's Test form is on an upswing and are looking particularly flawless at home. They are just coming after thumping New Zealand. For England to challenge the home side, they'll have to solidify their batting which looked shaky from what one saw in Bangladesh recently. Alastair Cook and Joe Root need to step up although the tourists boast of arguably the best lower order in Test cricket at the moment. The visitors will need to adapt better to spin than what they did against Bangladesh. Toss will be crucial too. The flip of the coin isn't far away.

Hello and welcome everyone! England's tour of India kicks off today with the first of the 5-match Test series beginning in Rajkot. The visitors are coming after a drawn series in Bangladesh and will need to raise their game considerably if they are to compete with the hosts. India haven't lost a Test at home since late 2012 which was coincidentally against their current opponents. England are also the only side to win a Test series in India in this decade. While all this is a morale booster for the tourists, a lot has changed since 2012.
